fields.headline: Student behavioral health partnership with Alameda Alliance for Health pays the district up to $1.69M
fields.summary: This memorandum of understanding (MOU) has the district carry out four interventions under the Student Behavioral Health Incentive Program, a state Medi-Cal program run locally by Alameda Alliance for Health: expanding wellness programs, expanding the behavioral health workforce, reaching targeted populations, and building partnerships to improve access to Medi-Cal services. The Alliance pays the district, up to $1,686,880.73, in installments tied to completed milestones and state approval; funds must be returned if milestones are not met. The period is January 1, 2023 through June 30, 2025.

23-1481.note: Earlier version showed this as money the district pays. The attached agreement shows the Alameda Alliance for Health pays the district up to $1,686,880.73.
23-1481.sourceIssue: The text states an amount not to exceed $1,686,880.73 but does not say whether the District pays it or receives it, and the title calls the item a Services Agreement while the text describes a memorandum of understanding.
